intro: The Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) are a set of 17 interlinked global goals established by the United Nations in 2015 as part of the 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development. They are designed to be a blueprint to achieve a better and more sustainable future for all by addressing various global challenges, including poverty, inequality, climate change, environmental degradation, peace, and justice. The mapping of PEOs with the SDGs are given in Table 6.1.

table_6_1.caption: Mapping of PEOs with SDGs
rows: PEO 1 – Excel in academia/industry/entrepreneurship + lifelong learning

SDG 4 – Quality Education
SDG 8 – Decent Work & Economic Growth
SDG 9 – Industry, Innovation & Infrastructure

SDG 4 promotes inclusive, equitable quality education and lifelong learning opportunities for all, directly supporting graduate excellence and continuous learning. SDG 8 aims for full and productive employment and decent work for all, aligning with excellence in industry and entrepreneurship. SDG 9 focuses on industry, innovation and infrastructure, supporting preparation for industrial careers and technological entrepreneurship.

SDG 3 – Good Health & Well-Being
SDG 9 – Industry, Innovation & Infrastructure

SDG 3 aims to ensure healthy lives and promote well-being for all, directly aligned with designing effective healthcare solutions. SDG 9 emphasizes innovation and infrastructure, supporting development of novel biomedical technologies and collaborations with industry.
PEO 3 – Ethics, leadership, communication, social responsibility

SDG 3 – Good Health & Well-Being
SDG 4 – Quality Education

SDG 3 connects to ethical responsibility in safeguarding health and well-being. SDG 4 includes targets on education for sustainable development, human rights and promotion of a culture of peace and non-violence, which relate to ethical and socially responsible graduates.

sdgList.label: SDG 1 No Poverty:
sdgList.text: End poverty in all its forms everywhere.

sdgList.label: SDG 2 Zero Hunger:
sdgList.text: End hunger, achieve food security and improved nutrition, and promote sustainable agriculture.

sdgList.label: SDG 3 Good Health and Well-being:
sdgList.text: Ensure healthy lives and promote well-being for all at all ages.

sdgList.label: SDG 4 Quality Education:
sdgList.text: Ensure inclusive and equitable quality education and promote lifelong learning opportunities for all.

sdgList.label: SDG 5 Gender Equality:
sdgList.text: Achieve gender equality and empower all women and girls.

sdgList.label: SDG 6 Clean Water and Sanitation:
sdgList.text: Ensure availability and sustainable management of water and sanitation for all.

sdgList.label: SDG 7 Affordable and Clean Energy:
sdgList.text: Ensure access to affordable, reliable, sustainable, and modern energy for all.

sdgList.label: SDG 8 Decent Work and Economic Growth:
sdgList.text: Promote sustained, inclusive, and sustainable economic growth, full and productive employment, and decent work for all.

sdgList.label: SDG 9 Industry, Innovation, and Infrastructure:
sdgList.text: Build resilient infrastructure, promote inclusive and sustainable industrialization, and foster innovation.

sdgList.label: SDG 10 Reduced Inequalities:
sdgList.text: Reduce inequality within and among countries.

sdgList.label: SDG 11 Sustainable Cities and Communities:
sdgList.text: Make cities and human settlements inclusive, safe, resilient, and sustainable.

sdgList.label: SDG 12 Responsible Consumption and Production:
sdgList.text: Ensure sustainable consumption and production patterns.

sdgList.label: SDG 13 Climate Action:
sdgList.text: Take urgent action to combat climate change and its impacts.

sdgList.label: SDG 14 Life below Water:
sdgList.text: Conserve and sustainably use the oceans, seas, and marine resources for sustainable development.

sdgList.label: SDG 15 Life on Land:
sdgList.text: Protect, restore, and promote sustainable use of terrestrial ecosystems, manage forests sustainably, combat desertification, halt and reverse land degradation, and halt biodiversity loss.

sdgList.label: SDG 16 Peace, Justice, and Strong Institutions:
sdgList.text: Promote peaceful and inclusive societies for sustainable development, provide access to justice for all, and build effective, accountable, and inclusive institutions at all levels.

sdgList.label: SDG 17 Partnerships for the Goals:
sdgList.text: Strengthen the means of implementation and revitalize the global partnership for sustainable development.
